title: starRating widget doesn't display a filter for 5 stars
body:
In the starRating widget, we're generating filters for 1+, 2+, 3+ and 4+ stars, but not for records with 5 stars only:
![capture d ecran 2016-07-28 a 15 31 17](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/314079/17214282/76ba7d3c-54d8-11e6-8781-63790c9bf1e3.png)

We could maybe also have an option to show a link to filter on records that have a 0 rating?
